text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 940 mm of 75 mm PVC pipe; square and deburr both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slots 5 x 50 mm: ten rows, four slots a row at 90 degrees apart. Row

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centres 55 mm from the bottom end, then every 85 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turn the slots 45 degrees off the line to the basin wall (where the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clamp rods are). Cut with a hand saw and file, or a router.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 3.5 mm pilot holes 20 mm below the top end, one each side, for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the screws that hold the drain head socket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the clamp positions: 80 and 710 mm below the top end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: hangs in the basin 90 mm from the curb-side wall on two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stand-off pipe clamps; top end 300 mm below the road; the open

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom end 60 mm above the basin floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 50 mm ball dropped in falls straight out of the bottom.
